final_report:
T83 decisive Playwright pass of the button-driven Socratic arc (learner-only via http://raspberrypi.local:8000/, health precheck ok, session 2283720ff6cd4c88abec834efb87b285).

RESULT: A1 PASS, A2 PASS, A3 PASS, A4 PASS; plan-mermaid-rail FAIL; A5 FAIL.

WHAT WORKS END-TO-END: fresh workspace renders no-session empty state; probe turn renders 3 interactive PROBE·01..03 cards with 5 radio options A)-E) and one 'Send answers' button (Sage's bubble does not restate questions); selection highlights (.selected + aria-checked); partial answering enables the button WITHOUT auto-submit; clicking it posts the exact ordinal user bubble '1: B; 2: E', marks all cards .sent and disables the button; single-card CHECK batch auto-submits ('1: A'). Grading turn narrates per-question outcomes ('You got the first one right!' / "you're unsure" + re-explanation) with no pre-grade leakage. build_plan ran (6-node plan verified in sidebar after reload). advance_lesson emitted exactly ONE teaching step ending in ONE CHECK card. Deliberately wrong CHECK answer got different-angle remediation (ladder metaphor vs spring metaphor) with a freshly-worded retry and NO advance - corroborated server-side (node 3 stayed current, phase badge flipped to 'remediate').

BROKEN LINK (naming as required): A5 - grade/advance after a failed check. After the wrong '1: A', the model never again called advance_lesson{passed_check:true}: five consecutive correct free-text answers, two explicit 'move to the next node' requests, and one explicit 'record my passed check with your lesson tool' request all produced inline re-teaching loops (winding/unwinding/base-case cycled three times) instead of a fresh CHECK card or an advance. Three page reloads confirm zero recorded progress: phase stuck at 'remediate', 'Winding and Unwinding' still current, nodes 4-6 unreachable. The machinery works when invoked (nodes 1->2->3 advanced earlier in this same session), so the fix belongs in playbook enforcement / prompt hardening (or a server-side fallback that grades explicit learner assertions) rather than in the card UI. Secondary gap: the expected plan mermaid artifact never reached the right rail (artifacts-count 0 all session) - the model skipped its mermaid presentation step, and the workspace UI has no SSE wiring to render a plan artifact regardless (only composer buttons / diagram-intent text create rail artifacts).

GLOBALS: 0 console errors beyond the accepted favicon 404; 0 thought-leak markers and no U+FFFD across all 24 bubbles; tool-phase status line could not be captured live at 150-500ms sampling (code path exists; flashes too briefly) - recorded honestly as not behaviorally confirmed. ENV notes: workspace Send is a silent no-op without ?session= (fresh-session bootstrap must go through the Sessions modal - used, UI-only); no stream exceeded ~50s (no ENV-TIMEOUT); interaction budget overrun to ~30 due to bootstrap detour plus six pushes against the A5 stall.
